description: Alembic (SQLAlchemy migrations): downgrades, upgrades and stamps (writes), and read commands.

rules.note: `downgrade` reverts migrations and can drop tables and columns. `downgrade base` reverts all. With `--sql` Alembic only prints the SQL.

safe.note: Revision state and history, SQL output without a database change, and a new revision file.

writes.note: `upgrade` applies migrations to the database. `stamp` changes the stored revision without running migrations. With `--sql` Alembic only prints the SQL.
